nodes.label: Gmail trigger on email from configured sender

outputs.name: email_event
outputs.description: Incoming Gmail message from the configured sender, carrying sender address, subject and the bill of lading attachment reference

requirement_evidence: The system triggers when a new Gmail email arrives from the configured specific sender
nodes.rationale: Declared triggering condition; the configured-sender filter is part of the trigger contract, separate from the declared attachment-download action.

nodes.label: Download attached bill of lading document

inputs.name: email_event
inputs.description: Email carrying the attachment to download

requirement_evidence: downloads the attached document (a bill of lading)
nodes.rationale: Declared allowed action with its own output contract (the downloaded document), distinct from the trigger event; deterministic retrieval.

nodes.label: Analyze attachment and rewrite bill of lading into structured Markdown

inputs.name: attachment_document
inputs.description: Bill of lading document to analyze

outputs.name: bol_markdown
outputs.description: Bill of lading content rewritten into the structured Markdown format

requirement_evidence: use a language model to analyze the attachment and rewrite the bill of lading content into a structured Markdown format
nodes.rationale: Document understanding and restructuring into Markdown requires open-text interpretation that deterministic rules cannot replace.

nodes.label: Convert Markdown into validated JSON fields via structured-output agent

outputs.name: bol_json
outputs.description: Validated JSON fields: shipper, consignee, shipment details, and line items, conforming to the structured output schema

requirement_evidence: use a second language model agent with a structured output schema to convert the Markdown into validated JSON fields for shipper, consignee, shipment details, and line items
nodes.rationale: Second, distinct language-model extraction step constrained by the structured output schema; declared as a separate action with its own output contract.

nodes.label: Programmatically validate order values against carrier line items

inputs.name: bol_json
inputs.description: Extracted JSON containing customer orders and carrier line items

outputs.name: validated_json
outputs.description: The JSON payload with an appended validation result comparing customer order package/weight values against carrier line items

requirement_evidence: run a programmatic validation that compares customer order package/weight values against the carrier line items and append a validation result to the JSON
nodes.rationale: Deterministic comparison rules over typed fields; fully declared programmatic logic.

nodes.label: Send JSON payload to external HTTP webhook endpoint

inputs.name: validated_json
inputs.description: The resulting JSON payload to deliver

requirement_evidence: send the resulting JSON payload to an external HTTP webhook endpoint
nodes.rationale: Declared external delivery of the structured JSON payload (a visible outcome). The linear flow continues to the reply steps, so it is modelled as code with a successor CFG edge; the webhook response is not consumed anywhere, so no output variable is declared.

nodes.label: Draft HTML acceptance reply email with language model

inputs.name: validated_json
inputs.description: Validated bill of lading data the reply is based on

outputs.name: html_reply
outputs.description: HTML acceptance reply email drafted from the validated data

requirement_evidence: use a language model to draft an HTML acceptance reply email based on the validated data
nodes.rationale: Open-text drafting of a styled acceptance email based on the validated data; cannot be replaced by frozen deterministic rules. Only validated data is consumed, per the requirement.

nodes.label: Send acceptance reply to original sender via Gmail

inputs.name: email_event
inputs.description: Provides the original sender address and subject for the reply

requirement_evidence: send it back to the original sender via Gmail
nodes.rationale: User-visible completion action: the original sender receives the HTML acceptance reply; terminal node with no outgoing CFG edge.

cfg_edges.rationale: The attachment is downloaded once the configured email arrives.
The downloaded document is analyzed next.
The Markdown rewrite is converted into JSON fields.
The extracted JSON is programmatically validated.
The validated payload is sent to the webhook.
After the webhook submission, the acceptance reply is drafted (declared step order 4 then 5).
The drafted reply is sent to the original sender.

dfg_edges.rationale: The download uses the email's attachment reference.
The language model analyzes the downloaded document.
The structured Markdown is the input of the JSON conversion.
Validation consumes the extracted JSON fields.
The webhook receives the validated JSON payload.
The reply is drafted based on the validated data.
The send action delivers the drafted HTML body.
The send action needs the original sender address and subject.

notes: 共识 Gold（8 节点线性管道）：触发→下载→Markdown 重写(semantic)→结构化 JSON 提取(semantic)→程序化校验(code)→webhook 投递(code)→HTML 回信草拟(semantic)→Gmail 发送(terminal)。裁决要点：①触发/下载拆分（需求分别以 conditions 与 allowed_action 声明，两个输出契约）；②webhook 投递无输出（响应未被消费）；③草拟仅消费 validated_json（需求 'based on the validated data'）；④发送消费 html_reply + email_event。混合任务类型边：n4(semantic)→n5(code, bol_json)、n5(code)→n7(semantic) 均有类型边。排除未声明实现：Gemini fallback 模型子节点（模型选择细节）。
